description: Full-structure proposal: one compliant car archetype, motorcycles split into standard, slow and space-seeking (custom1); red running and early start for motorcycles only; separate illegal-left riders. Cars no longer carry queue_space_seeking.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant cars: M3/share/car 0.0041 and M2/early/car 0.011 are near zero, so no red-running rule applies; tau 0.9 s and sigma 0.4 target the M1/car discharge headway 0.35 s and M6 car approach times.

Main motorcycle population: small tau, minGap, compact lateral alignment and high lcSublane/lcPushy to filter forward, targeting M1/moto headway 0.30 s, M4 overshoot share 0.62 and M5 moto density 0.052 veh/m2.
Slow riders in the lane centre (behaviour 10): a minority with speedFactor 0.7 lengthens M6 approach times without moving the mean far from the observed values.
Motorcycles that may seek space (wrong lane, sidewalk); share 0.25 matches M8/moto wrong-lane share 0.249, with the same filtering parameters as moto_std.
Illegal-left riders from HDT_N and HDT_S; jmTimegapMinor kept at the SUMO default 1 s because there is no feedback yet on M7a 5.6 waiters or M7b 5.5 s clear lag.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto 0.130 share in the last 10 s of red: p set to the observed share, lead time 7 s inside the 4-10 s target window, creep cap 2.5 m/s.

M3/share/moto 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 3.9 with var/mean 1.14: low base probability with a mild group effect gives a mean near the target and some overdispersion; cars excluded because M3/share/car is 0.004.

Trigger at q = 10 m since observed queues are about 16 m (M5/length 15.8) and choices occur at q0-40 m; p_sidewalk 0.1 targets F2/p/sidewalk 0.009-0.049 and M10a 0.56 veh/cycle, p_wrong_lane 0.4 targets F2/p/wrong_lane 0.19-0.23; p_right_lane 0 because it does not exist on this site. Applied to the custom1 archetype only, since custom2 has no existing option here.
M7a/release_time 2.78 s and M7b/clear_lag 5.46 s after the opposing green ends: a moderate extra hold of 1 s on top of SUMO's native release, to be adjusted once feedback is available.
Slow motorcycles keep near the lane centre (behaviour 10); a small 0.2 m offset stays well inside the 3.5 m lane and avoids pushing M4/lat_moto.
